'''Clea Sook''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a hard-edged woman and was distinguished by the black [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] covering her face and hands.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Sook was hired by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] to track down [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and kill him for X-7's master. When she arrived to meet X-7, he attacked her and the other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to test if they were worthy to work for him. She survived and was told she had to work in a team led by [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Lune Divinian]]. They tracked Skywalker heading to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and attacked his team, but was surprised when everyone, including her, crashed on to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She survived and tried to attack Divinian, but he disarmed her and let her walk away.

Later, when she was still trapped on the planet, Clea recaptured her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Divinian, but a monster came up behind her and ate her.
